raw_text_content: Scuttlebutt Pub - Foley, AL. Enter as a Stranger, Leave as a Friend. Welcome to Scuttlebutt Pub, your ultimate destination for jazz, karaoke, and more in Foley, Alabama. Located at 319 A N McKenzie St, Foley, AL 36535. Phone: (251) 971-6403. Open Daily: 11am - 2am. When you're here, you're having fun, you're family. And although you may come as a stranger, you'll leave as a friend. Check out our assortment of craft cocktails & drinks from the bar. Join us for a night out with live jazz, karaoke, pool, and giant Jenga games on our outdoor patio. Services include: Craft Cocktails, Classic Cocktails, Prohibition Style Cocktails, Old Fashioned, Whiskey Drinks, Bourbon Cocktails, Signature Shooters, Shot Specials, Fun Bar Drinks.
